name: KaiserWindow::EmailGameStep
comment: E-mail game sequencer over game_state 2..14: after each step saves the game for the next human and returns to state 0. States 3/8/9/0xb-0xe = phases of a pending battle (data in the 0x192 extra block at Self+0x4493)

name: KaiserWindow::BeginHumanTurn
comment: game_state=6, runs the start-of-turn processing 1010:37b6, game_state = its result, then autosave to autosave.ksr if Opt_Autosave and not e-mail

name: KaiserWindow::NextPlayer
comment: current_player++, wraps to 0 with year++; skips players with skip_turn (clearing it); runs CpuTurn for computer players and checks victory (title 10)

name: KaiserWindow::CpuTurn
comment: Computer player turn: AI economy 1008:0002, AI war-target choice 1008:24eb (war -> ResolveWar), AI end of turn 1008:29ea

name: KaiserWindow::ResolveWar
comment: War of current_player against param target: battle 1018:0558 (retried once on result 3), news item 8 (won) or 9 (lost)

name: KaiserWindow::Victory
comment: Title 10 reached: coronation 1040:4bc7; for humans without census editor also high score 1040:3fc4 / records 1040:4557; then 1000:0a6f

name: KaiserWindow::EndGame
comment: Called after victory / game end; plays kaiser.mid

name: PlayerTurnStart
comment: Start-of-turn processing for the current player (4 KB, 66 calls); result != 0 keeps the game running. Called only from BeginHumanTurn

name: PlayerTurnEnd
comment: End-of-turn processing for the current player, called first in CmBeenden

name: Ai_Economy
comment: First step of CpuTurn (segment 2 = AI unit)

name: Ai_ChooseWarTarget
comment: CpuTurn: returns true + target player index when the computer declares war

name: Ai_EndTurn
comment: Last step of CpuTurn; also called after a war turn in EmailGameStep

name: Battle
comment: Battle between current player and target; result 1 = won, 3 = retry once

name: AddNews
comment: News / Klatsch-und-Tratsch entry: (kind, player, other, num_players, players). kinds seen: 8 war won, 9 war lost, 0x10 eliminated

name: SetupComputerPlayers
comment: New game: computer player setup (dialogs COMPUTERZAHLDLG, MANOEVERNOIPDLG)

name: CensusEditor
comment: Hidden cmd 802 (Ctrl+P): PASSWORDDLG, then if the password matches and header.census_editor_enabled: CENSUSDLG edits all 10 player records (copies 0x4452 bytes back)
